Name: Minerva's Harder Community Center Bundles
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A somewhat harder Community Center challenge with better rewards
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Exactly what is says on the box, a harder Community Center challenge, mainly for those playing this game for the umpteenth time.

Now with easy and hard modes, along with an update to the original version to rebalance it.  Thanks to my play testers on the SDV #modding discord for helping out!

And FINALLY with a PPJA version!  Also requires New Fish for the fish bundles.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) and [Mail Framework Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536)﻿.  If you are using the PPJA option, you also need the [entire main PPJA collection](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26612284?tab=user+files)﻿ of crops (excluding Cannabis Kit and Starbrew) and [More New Fish](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578)﻿, as well as [Farm Type Manager](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231)﻿.

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the 'Minerva's Harder CC Bundles' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game once to generate the config file, choose from "easy", "regular", "hard", "PPJA", "HanazakiRebalance", and "OJRebalance" modes.  Defaults to "regular".

5.  You're done; run the game using SMAPI!
Notes
Please see the articles tab for information on bundle rewards, as well as some bonus background information on the changes.  Not all bundles were completed during testing, so please let me know if you find any bugs!

By request, a comparison of the different versions can now be found on [this mod's wiki](https://github.com/minervamaga/MinervaModsWiki/wiki)!  Beware spoilers.
